designs.label: 热点发现 · 聚合多个信息源
designs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Refine the supplied approved Content Studio hotspot-discovery screenshot. Input is edit target and visual shell reference. Keep identical warm ivory center, sand sidebars, forest-green actions, terracotta selection, Chinese serif headings, 18% left / 52% center / 30% persistent Agent layout. Flat full 16:10 app screenshot, no browser/device/scenery.
Main change: make MULTIPLE SOURCE TYPES first-class, while keeping topic aggregation and creation flow. These are fictional UI examples; retain visible "设计示例 · 非实时热点". Do not imply actual integrations, live rankings or current news.
Preserve left 热点 selected, 素材库, 内容库 and project list. Center heading "从热点，找到你的表达", subtitle "汇集多个信息源，再找到自己的创作角度。". Top right buttons "来源管理" with sliders icon, "收藏", "刷新".
Search 搜索热点或关键词…. Domain tabs 综合 / AI 科技 / 职场 / 生活 / 文化. Beneath a COMPACT source-type filter strip "全部类型" SELECTED / "平台热榜" / "新闻资讯" / "RSS". Small text "4 个信息源已启用"; quiet source dropdown "全部信息源" and time dropdown 近24小时, latest sort active if room. Filters distinguish source type from topic category, not source as output platform.
Four tidy single-column topic cards, modest thumbnail photos as reference. Each item has explicit MULTI-SOURCE label and inspectable sources:
1 AI 工具能帮普通人持续创作吗？ / AI 科技 / small "2 个来源" / "知乎 · 小红书". Description 围绕工具选择、创作习惯和个人表达的讨论. Green 查看与创作, bookmark 收藏.
2 越来越多人用纸质笔记找回专注 / 生活 / "2 个来源" / "新闻资讯 · RSS 订阅". Context 从记录习惯与注意力管理切入.
3 通勤时间，怎样变成自己的时间 / 职场 / "2 个来源" / "知乎 · RSS 订阅". 已创作1篇 badge, link 查看已有内容.
4 普通人的小作品，为什么值得被看见 / 文化 / "2 个来源" / "小红书 · 新闻资讯".
All use source text labels, not fake shared popularity score. Bottom helper "同一话题汇总展示，各来源的原文与排名单独保留。".
Right user "希望把热榜、新闻和我的 RSS 放在一起找选题。". Agent "可以按来源类型筛选，也可以在来源管理里启用你关心的信息源。同一话题会合并展示，你仍能查看每个来源的原文。". Small reference card first topic / 2 个来源 · 可选角度. Bottom 当前热点：AI工具与个人创作 × / 想优先看看哪类来源？.
Keep same app, all four cards and source controls visible, no permanent extra sidebar, no real article quotes or unverified links.

designs.label: 热点信息源 · 类型与独立管理
designs.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create source-management screen in SAME approved Content Studio from supplied reference (style/layout reference only). Warm ivory central workspace, sand side panes, forest-green primary actions, restrained terracotta active highlights, thin separators, Chinese serif heading and sans-serif UI. Three columns 18% library /52% center /30% Agent. Full edge-to-edge landscape16:10 flat app screenshot, no device/browser/extra sidebar.
Left keep brand Content Studio, + 新建内容, search, 热点 SELECTED, 素材库, 内容库 projects and 设置. Main back link ← 返回热点, heading "热点信息源", subtitle "管理信息从哪里来，而不是发布到哪里。". Small visible badge "设计示例 · 尚未连接真实来源". Top right one forest-green "+ 添加信息源".
Type filters 全部（6） SELECTED / 平台热榜（3） / 新闻资讯（1） / RSS（1） / 自定义（1）. Compact summary "已启用 4 / 6" and muted "可用状态为设计示例". No live fetch success claims beyond demonstrative state label.
Central six clear single-column source rows with columns 信息源 / 类型 / 状态 / 启用. Use warm understated cards or fine table rows with simple icons, not large third-party brand artwork:
1 "知乎热榜" type 平台热榜, status 示例可用, switch ON, row action 设置
2 "小红书话题" type 平台热榜, status 示例可用, switch ON, 设置
3 "X 趋势" type 平台热榜, status 待配置, switch OFF, 去配置
4 "科技新闻精选" type 新闻资讯, status 示例可用, switch ON, 设置
5 "我的 RSS 订阅" type RSS, subtitle 个人关注的订阅源, status 示例可用, switch ON, 编辑订阅
6 "自定义信息源" type 自定义, status 未连接, switch OFF, 配置
Exactly four ON, two OFF; clearly separate notconfigured from disabled, do not visually claim all APIs implemented. Specific names are candidate/sample source entries, no availability guarantees.
Under rows a quiet explanation block "同一话题可以来自多个源" with simple connected-text diagram [平台热榜] + [新闻资讯] + [RSS] → [聚合话题]. One line "来源原文、发布时间和来源内排名分别保留。". Another small note "停用信息源后，已保存的素材与引用仍然保留。". No destructive global delete primary.
Right Agent user "热点应该会有多个信息源，最好能分别管理。". Assistant "这里把来源分成平台热榜、新闻资讯、RSS 和自定义来源。你可以单独启用或配置；浏览时按类型筛选，选题时再决定引用哪些原文。". One small informational card "聚合规则" with three short rows "同话题归并" / "原文可回查" / "排名按来源展示". NO duplicate configuration CTA in chat. Composer context 当前页面：信息源管理 × / 描述你想关注的信息来源… .
Constraints: this is a SOURCE system distinct from publication destinations. No model/API keys in default creator-facing view, technical configuration hidden behind 设置/去配置; no false connected accounts, fake numeric rankings, actual news, or cloud monitor. All rows readable and full app consistent.
